description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian woman in her late 70s with a soft, pastel-coloured tudung covering her grey hair. She wears a traditional floral Baju Kurung in soft cotton and simple sandals. She has a gentle, aged appearance with subtle wrinkles.
FULL BODY. A Malaysian man in his early 40s with short black hair. He is dressed in a smart-casual office attire consisting of a light blue collared shirt, dark grey slacks, and black leather shoes.

FULL BODY. An anonymous, featureless human silhouette draped in a dark hoodie. The figure is surrounded by glowing blue digital voice waveforms and binary code patterns that trail off its limbs like static.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian male officer in his mid-40s with a clean-shaven face and short military-style haircut. He is wearing a formal dark navy blue police uniform with silver badges, insignia on the shoulders, and polished black boots.
